options.plan: Basic MAU; documented free allowance, no tenant entitlement verified
options.region: No tenant region selected; storage destinations not verified
options.configuration: Standard-mode external tenant; native downstream OIDC/SAML apps; no inbound SCIM paid add-on or Graph bridge

conditions: Basic pricing at https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/pricing/details/microsoft-entra-external-id/ includes the first 50,000 MAUs; usage and paid add-ons require separate billing review, not a zero-cost guarantee.
Register a single-tenant downstream application, configure redirect URIs, bind its sign-up/sign-in user flow and use the tenant ciamlogin.com authority with authorization code and PKCE.
This is external-tenant customer login, not workforce guest access, legacy Azure AD B2C or upstream enterprise federation; no tenant entitlement or runtime integration was tested.

evidence.summary: The external-tenant feature table describes registered OIDC applications, code flow and PKCE. Proposed OPTIONAL refers to configurable downstream login, not a configured tenant or complete application compatibility.

conditions: Configure a non-gallery Enterprise application for the downstream SAML relying party, its metadata, signing certificate and claims, then associate the customer sign-up/sign-in user flow.
The admin-center Test button signs in the current administrator; customer authentication must be tested by running the actual application with its user flow.
A downstream SAML application does not establish upstream federation or ENTERPRISE_SSO; Basic tenant entitlement, billing and application integration remain unverified.

evidence.summary: The external-tenant guide describes registering a SAML relying party and distinguishes administrator portal testing from customer user-flow login. This is a documentation proposal, not a tested application.

conditions: The required path is inbound customer-directory provisioning into this external tenant, not outbound provisioning from Entra into another application.
The documented SCIM Provisioning API requires P1 and an Azure-linked paid add-on; that path is excluded from this Basic scope and its applicability to an external tenant is not established.
Standard-mode outbound SCIM is distinct; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/external-id/customers/reference-service-limits excludes that outbound feature in HSC mode, not all external tenants.
UNKNOWN is not UNAVAILABLE: establish external-tenant inbound entitlement, endpoint, identity mapping and consuming-application access/session enforcement before assigning availability.

evidence.summary: The inbound SCIM API guide describes a separately billed Entra server interface. It does not establish a native inbound customer-directory endpoint for the selected Basic external tenant without paid add-ons.

conditions: Graph/admin-center group CRUD, membership edits, application-role assignments and token group claims are not native inbound SCIM Group lifecycle evidence.
No Graph bridge is selected; inbound group entitlement, membership changes and deletions for this Basic external tenant remain unverified.
Confirm application-side authorization and local-session behavior separately; UNKNOWN must not be read as absence of all group-management APIs.

evidence.summary: The external-tenant table lists user/group management and role assignments through administration or Microsoft Graph. These controls do not prove the selected native inbound SCIM Group synchronization path.
